sites.name: Morrison Spring

sites.name: S.S. Inchulva / Delray Wreck (Wrack)
sites.desc: The old shipwreck know as the Delray Wreck rests at the bottom of the ocean in 25 feet of water about 150 yards offshore the south end of Delray’s municipal beach.

sites.name: SS Copenhagen Shipwreck
sites.desc: SS Copenhagen is a shipwreck off the town of Lauderdale-by-the-Sea, Florida, United States. She was a cargo steamship, built in England in 1898. She was wrecked on a reef south of Hillsboro Inlet in 1900.

sites.name: Sebastian Inlet
sites.desc: Scuba diving is permitted in all of the waters of Sebastian Inlet State Park, with the exception of under the Sebastian Inlet Bridge and in the boat channel. Rock reefs stretch for miles starting south of Sebastian Inlet in the nearshore waters.

sites.name: USS Massachusetts
sites.desc: US Navy pre-dreadnaught battleship, served in the Spanish American War and the First World War, sunk as a target in 1921.

sites.name: Vortex Spring
sites.desc: The spring basin is 50 feet deep at the mouth of the cavern. Surface lit during the day and inhabited by Koi, Gar, Catfish, American Eels, Blue Gill, and Bass to name a few.  The cavern continues another one hundred yards, to a depth of 115 feet.
